reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Helm option for deploying a managed etcd instance via `etcd.managed` and other related Helm configurations have been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The etcd.managed Helm configuration value will no longer be honored in Cilium 1.16.0; environments using this setting must migrate to an alternative etcd deployment method.
consequence.remediation: Remove the etcd.managed configuration and any related etcd Helm values from your values.yaml. Deploy etcd independently or use an existing etcd cluster without relying on Cilium's managed etcd functionality.

proposed.statement: The Helm option for deploying a managed etcd instance via etcd.managed and other related Helm configurations have been removed.
